title: Senior Sales Operations
description:
What is the scope of this role?

The Sr. Sales Operations Specialist will be responsible for optimizing sales processes, providing analytical support and managing sales tools to ensure that our sales organization meets its targets. This role requires a blend of proactive thinking, operational expertise, and excellent communication skills.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary contact and escalation point for the global Sales team for day-to-day sales operations needs.
  • Develop and improve efficiency of the operational processes and workflows to enhance team productivity and sales performance.
  • Ensure due diligence is conducted on each new sales opportunity with proper analysis to ensure efficiencies prior to commencing the sales cycle.
  • Work closely with Business Profitability Management and Revenue Teams to perform additional sales deal analysis and work interactively with the sales team to maximize efficiencies for each sales opportunity throughout the sales process.
  • Assist in clean up, maintenance, and enforcement of proper usage of CRM tool and ensure data accuracy and integrity within all internal systems.
  • Assist in managing the sales pipeline and forecasts, coordinating and facilitating sales transactions.
  • Coordination of internal approval process of corporate contracts including final documents review and summary set up in ticketing system (JIRA) and validation with necessary departments for contract approval Internal contract review and review for compliance against corporate / internal policies
  • Analysis and approval of customer’s purchase orders and management of internal license data base of the sold products in Jira.
  • Work closely with marketing, delivery, engineering, and product management teams to support sales initiatives and ensure alignment.
  • Work closely with Finance to provide oversight and execution of daily, weekly, and monthly reports, including pipeline management, sales analysis, win/loss analysis, and sales metrics.
  • Help prepare presentations and materials for the sales team as needed.
  • Participate in qualification calls with the sales team and senior management and assist in capturing meeting notes and action items.
  • Adhoc projects as required

Qualifications:

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Strong understanding and experience in working in a global sales team or with a global sales team
  • Familiarity with any Sales Force automation tool
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools
  • Proven experience managing simultaneous multiple priorities
  • Ability to partner cross functionally throughout the company
  • Strong MS excel and PPT skills
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment\
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Knowledge of business communication via emailing, presentations, conference meetings
  • Strong organizational and decision-making skills

title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.

Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets

Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation

Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options

Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization

Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred
  • Familiarity with embedded BI/analytics tools (QuickSight, GoodData) and semantic layer concepts

Desired Experience

  • Experience with schema-per-tenant architectures and automated tenant provisioning
  • Familiarity with Auth0 / SSO integration for analytics tools (e.g., QuickSight embedding)
  • Experience implementing observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, Monte Carlo, Soda Core)
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-oriented design principles
  • Prior experience in hospitality / property-management SaaS product ecosystems

Additional Information

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. title: Supervisor(a) Manutenção Logística (Estradas e Carregamento)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Desafio:

Supervisionar e garantir a execução eficiente das atividades de manutenção dos equipamentos de malha viária (motoniveladoras, rolos, tratores, caminhões de apoio) e dos equipamentos de carregamento tipo grua, assegurando disponibilidade operacional, segurança, confiabilidade e controle de custos, em apoio direto às operações logísticas.

Principais Atividades:

  • Liderar e auditar o desempenho das equipes próprias e terceiras parceiras, monitorando disponibilidade de frota, produtividade, segurança e custo.
  • Conduzir a melhoria contínua, mapeando oportunidades, priorizando iniciativas e assegurando a implementação de ações que elevem segurança, produtividade, qualidade e eficiência de custos.
  • Participar da construção do planejamento semanal, mensal e anual de manutenção, assim como construir em conjunto com as áreas clientes como será o plano operacional dos períodos.
  • Gerenciar a manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva da frota logística (gruas, caminhões, máquinas amarelas etc.).
  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe, assegurando clima organizacional positivo e alinhamento aos pilares de segurança, qualidade, produtividade e eficiência de custos, por meio de acompanhamento, orientação e suporte contínuos e participação ativa na construção e plano de recrutamento, seleção e treinamento.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade da área e diretrizes da liderança.
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir as políticas de Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional e Ética/Compliance, junto a colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando aderência à legislação, compromissos corporativos e requisitos normativos (normas e ISOs aplicáveis) em atividades, produtos e serviços.
  • Realizar diagnóstico de falhas mecânicas, hidráulicas e elétricas, principalmente em sistemas de gruas (lança, giro, estabilizadores, comandos hidráulicos).
  • Controlar consumo de peças, pneus, lubrificantes e componentes estruturais.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, especialmente NR-11, NR-12, NR-18 e NR-31 (quando aplicável).
  • Apoiar a operação na priorização de equipamentos, conforme janelas de carregamento e condições da malha viária.
  • Registrar e acompanhar indicadores de manutenção (disponibilidade, MTTR, falhas recorrentes).

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo em Logística, Mecânica, Administração, Economia, Engenharias relacionadas às áreas florestal, civil e industrial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização completa ou em andamento em Gestão de Custos, Supply Chain Management, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas será um diferencial;

title: Technical Project Specialist
description:
ZTE is looking for The Technical Project Specialist – Data Center / IDC is a hybrid technical delivery and project execution role , responsible for supporting end-to-end delivery of Integrated Data Center (IDC) / Mission Critical E&M projects , from bid support and estimation through planning, site execution, commissioning, acceptance, and handover .

This role operates in a matrix organization , with no direct people management , and acts as a technical project owner at execution level , coordinating internal teams and external contractors to ensure scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and acceptance objectives are met.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Support end-to-end project delivery for Data Center / IDC E&M projects , including electrical and HVAC scope.
  • Translate bid assumptions into execution plans, schedules, and acceptance criteria .
  • Coordinate site execution activities in alignment with approved scope, schedule, and quality standards.

Bid Support, Estimation & BOM

  • Support bidding and pre-sales activities with technical inputs.
  • Prepare or validate cost estimations , Bill of Materials (BOM) , and delivery assumptions.
  • Provide technical and execution inputs to protect project feasibility and margins.

Planning & Schedule Control

  • Develop and maintain baseline project schedules (e.g., MS Project, Primavera or equivalent).
  • Track progress, critical path, risks, and deviations, proposing corrective and mitigation actions.

Site Coordination (Matrix Environment)

  • Coordinate technical activities across engineering, supply chain, quality, HSE, finance/contracts , and external vendors/subcontractors .
  • Ensure alignment on scope, cost, schedule, quality, safety, testing, and acceptance readiness .
  • Act as a technical focal point during execution, without direct people management.

Quality, HSE & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support and verify compliance with HSE, site safety, and quality requirements .
  • Ensure adherence to applicable Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) , including NR-10 (Electrical Safety) and NR-35 (Work at Height) , according to project scope.
  • Support audits, inspections, and closure of non-conformities.

Commissioning, Acceptance & Handover

  • Coordinate commissioning and acceptance readiness , including punch lists, test evidence, and acceptance documentation.
  • Support preparation of as-built documentation and handover packages to customers.

Cost Control & Collections Interface

  • Track execution cost drivers and efficiency.
  • Support payment milestone and collections readiness by ensuring technical and acceptance deliverables are completed in line with contractual requirements.

Process Improvement & Digital Tools

  • Support implementation and continuous improvement of IDC delivery processes, controls, and reporting .
  • Promote use of digital tools for planning, reporting, and documentation control.

Stakeholder & Customer Interface

  • Act as a technical interface with customers, internal stakeholders, and partners .
  • Support customer satisfaction through transparent communication and execution discipline.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Center (IDC) / Mission Critical infrastructure project delivery ,
  • or equivalent experience in critical electrical or HVAC construction projects with site exposure.
  • Proven experience supporting project execution and customer acceptance in construction or mission-critical environments.
  • Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Industrial/Production Engineering , or related fields is preferred .
  • Technical/technologist degrees may be considered with strong hands-on experience in mission-critical environments.
  • English : Advanced ( mandatory ) – spoken and written.
  • Portuguese : Fluent ( mandatory ).
  • Mandarin Chinese and/or Spanish: nice to have.
  • Solid knowledge of electrical systems or HVAC for data centers or mission-critical facilities.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, site documentation, and specifications .
  • Experience with AutoCAD or equivalent CAD tools.
  • Strong understanding of project delivery, execution tracking, risk and issue management , and acceptance preparation.
  • Basic contract and scope awareness related to milestones, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.
  • Advanced English (spoken and written).
  • Strong communication and coordination skills in multi-stakeholder environments.

Mobility

Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally.

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • MBA or Postgraduate degree in Project Management, Operations, or Engineering.
  • Experience in large-scale or international data center projects .
  • Familiarity with commissioning and testing of mission-critical facilities.
  • Experience with MS Project, Primavera , advanced Excel, or reporting tools.
  • Exposure to documentation control , including change logs, punch lists, and handover documentation.
  • Knowledge of HSE practices in construction or critical environments.

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.

Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.

Diferenciais

title: Senior Finance Manager
description:
As the Senior Finance Manager for LATAM , you will be the cornerstone of our financial operations in the region. You will oversee all financial reporting, tax compliance, and treasury functions for our entities in Mexico and Brazil. You will act as a strategic partner to the global finance team, ensuring that our expansion is commercially viable, compliant with local laws, and operationally efficient.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Controllership & Financial Reporting

  • Monthly Financial Oversight: Lead and review the month-end closing process for LATAM entities (Brazil/Mexico), ensuring accurate reporting under Local GAAP and IFRS .
  • Financial Integrity: Implement and maintain robust internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure compliance with global corporate policies.
  • Consolidation: Standardize financial workflows and reporting templates across different LATAM jurisdictions to ensure data consistency.

Tax & Statutory Compliance

  • Local Tax Management: Supervise complex tax compliance in Brazil (Direct/Indirect taxes) and Mexico (VAT/ISR/Electronic Accounting).
  • Audit Management: Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors and statutory bodies, ensuring timely and "clean" audit completions.
  • Agent Governance: Manage and hold accountable third-party corporate secretarial, tax, and legal agents across the region.

Strategic Business Expansion

  • Entity Setup: Project manage the financial and administrative aspects of new company incorporations in the region (including banking setup and tax registrations).
  • Treasury & FX: Manage regional cash flow, local liquidity, and mitigate foreign exchange risks within the LATAM portfolio.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in finance/accounting, with at least 3 years in a regional leadership role within a multinational company.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics. An MBA or professional certification (CPA, CA, or local equivalent like CRC in Brazil) is highly preferred.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory. Proficiency in both Spanish and Portuguese is a massive advantage given the cross-border nature of the role.
  • Deep knowledge of Latin American tax systems and experience with global ERPs (e.g., NetSuite, or Xero).
  • Strong cross-cultural communication, ability to work across time zones, and a "startup" mindset for building processes from scratch.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior (C# / React)
description:
Venha fazer parte do i4time para juntos, impulsionarmos o mercado segurador do Brasil com tecnologia e inovação!

O que fazemos?

A i4pro é líder em soluções tecnológicas para o mercado segurador e a única empresa brasileira que atende todos os ramos regulados pela Susep.

Oferecemos soluções de administração de apólice de ponta a ponta, com experiência SaaS.

Somando alta tecnologia, experiência, conhecimento especializado e inovação, promovemos redução de custos, riscos operacionais e despesas em TI, possibilitamos que as seguradoras cresçam ao focar em seu core business.

Acreditamos que a simplicidade e agilidade são as chaves para a eficácia, ao tornar processos e experiências acessíveis e descomplicadas.

Hoje, temos mais de 270 colaboradores que fazem acontecer e +40 seguradoras que aproveitam os benefícios de nossos produtos e serviços!

Em 2025, pelo quinto ano consecutivo, recebemos a certificação do Great Place to Work (GPTW).

i4pro + você = i4evc

Ao longo de sua jornada na i4pro, você terá diversas oportunidades para se desenvolver, evoluir e transformar, tudo isso em um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e saudável que preza pelo reconhecimento, valorização e bem-estar de todos. Assim, contamos com você para:

· Arquitetar e desenvolver serviços e APIs em C# (.NET / .NET Core) seguindo boas práticas (REST, SOLID, Clean Architecture, Clean Code).

· Desenvolver e manter interfaces React escaláveis e acessíveis (Hooks, Context, estado global; preferencialmente com TypeScript).

· Modelar dados e implementar consultas eficientes em bancos SQL (ex.: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL) e NoSQL (ex.: MongoDB, DynamoDB).

· Containerizar aplicações e configurar ambientes com Docker (multi-stage builds, compose), apoiando pipelines de CI/CD.

· Garantir qualidade com testes unitários, de integração e end-to-end, revisão de código e boas práticas de engenharia.

· Zelar por segurança (authN/authZ, OWASP Top 10), observabilidade (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing) e performance.

· Mentorar o time, disseminar boas práticas e participar ativamente de code reviews e design reviews.

· Colaborar com Produto, QA e UX para descoberta e entrega contínua (Lean, Agile, Kanban/Scrum).

· Escrever documentação técnica clara e sustentável (arquitetura, decisões técnicas, guias de setup).

Você também precisa ter:

· Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend com C# (.NET) e frontend com React.

· Domínio de APIs REST, versionamento de APIs e integração com serviços externos.

· Experiência prática com .NET Core, injeção de dependência, middlewares e pipelines

· Prática avançada com Docker em projetos reais (build, distribuição e execução em diferentes ambientes).

· Experiência comprovada com SQL (modelagem relacional, queries otimizadas) e NoSQL.

· Conhecimento em Git, CI/CD, testes automatizados e integração contínua (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps).

· Vivência em arquiteturas escaláveis, caching, mensageria (ex.: RabbitMQ, Kafka) e observabilidade.

· Boa comunicação, autonomia e forte postura de ownership.

· Graduação em área de tecnologia.

Se você tiver, será um diferencial:

· Práticas de “vibe coding”, utilizando agentes, prompts e IDEs modernas (Cursor, VS Code + agentes).

· Experiência com Entity Framework Core, Dapper ou ORMs similares.

· Conhecimento em TypeScript no frontend.

· Frameworks do ecossistema React (Next.js, React Query, Redux Toolkit).

· Experiência em Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP), infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e Kubernetes.

· Segurança de APIs (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), feature flags, blue/green ou canary releases.

· Participação ativa em comunidades, artigos técnicos ou contribuições open source.

Nosso modelo de trabalho:

Priorizamos o bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores, com posições em formato remoto, presencial ou presencial com política de home office, que é definido conforme as necessidades da vaga e as atribuições do cargo.

No caso dessa posição, a atuação é de forma remota.

Nosso escritório fica na Avenida Angélica, 2133 – próximo do metrô Paulista.

A i4pro apoia a diversidade e inclusão de PCD em todas as suas vagas.

title: Senior / Staff React Native Engineer
description:
Project Description

We are building WON , a high-performance, mobile-first cryptocurrency trading terminal focused on robust infrastructure, performance, and distributed systems .

The goal of the project is to deliver a professional trading experience within a single mobile interface, including:

  • Real-time mobile applications
  • Advanced data visualization and charting
  • Real-time communication with backend systems (WebSockets)
  • High reliability, low latency, and excellent UX
  • A scalable architecture built for long-term growth

The mobile frontend is a critical part of the system , as it is the direct interface between users and complex trading flows with real-time data.

Role Description

We are looking for a Senior / Staff React Native Engineer to lead and execute the development of the core mobile application.

This is not a junior role and not purely execution-focused . We are looking for strong technical judgment, real production experience, and the autonomy to make architectural and implementation decisions.

What You’ll Work On
  • Architecture and development of complex mobile applications
  • Implementation of real-time data flows
  • Integration with backend APIs and services
  • Performance optimization and user experience improvements
  • Direct collaboration with backend engineers and product
Responsibilities
  • Design and build robust mobile applications using React Native
  • Implement real-time communication (WebSockets, streams)
  • Integrate REST APIs and complex backend services
  • Optimize performance, stability, and UX
  • Actively participate in frontend technical decisions
  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers and product managers
  • Ensure code quality and production best practices
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience with React
  • 3+ years of hands-on React Native experience
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript
  • Proven experience working on production mobile applications
  • Experience with:
  • Real-time applications
  • API consumption
  • State management
  • Ability to work autonomously in remote environments
  • Must be located in Brazil
English Requirement (IMPORTANT)

Intermediate to advanced English is required.

You must be able to:

  • Read technical documentation in English
  • Write technical messages in English
  • Participate in technical calls in English

The client is international.

Nice to Have (Plus)
  • Experience in fintech, trading, or financial products
  • Experience with charts, data visualization, or dashboards
  • Experience publishing apps to App Store / Google Play
  • Strong mobile-first mindset and UX focus
  • Experience working with international remote teams

Royal Enfield - About Us

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfields are engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach the brand calls Pure Motorcycling .

Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.

Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
ZTE is looking for Regulatory Affairs & Product Certification Manager

Role Purpose

We are seeking a senior Regulatory Affairs & Product Certification Manager to act as the single owner and authority for all Anatel regulatory compliance and product certification activities in Brazil.

This role is critical to ensuring the company’s ability to import, commercialize, deploy, and operate telecommunications products in the Brazilian market, while enabling speed-to-market, commercial competitiveness, and long-term regulatory sustainability.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership, strong interaction with Global HQ, and direct influence on revenue, deployment, and customer trust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the full lifecycle of Anatel homologation and product certification activities, including planning, execution, publication, maintenance, renewals, and amendments.
  • Act as the single point of accountability with Anatel, OCDs (Designated Certification Bodies), and accredited laboratories.
  • Define and execute regulatory strategies per product family, balancing compliance, cost efficiency, risk mitigation, and time-to-market.
  • Coordinate and validate all regulatory and technical documentation, including test reports, declarations of conformity, manuals in Portuguese, and technical files.
  • Assess the regulatory impact of hardware, firmware, RF, and configuration changes, enforcing regulatory gates and blocking deployments when compliance is at risk.
  • Ensure strict alignment between certified configurations and field-deployed products, SKUs, and software versions.
  • Support Sales, Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, and Supply Chain with regulatory validation for RFPs, RFQs, imports, and network deployments.
  • Maintain an audit-ready regulatory repository and manage interactions with Anatel during audits, inspections, and formal inquiries.
  • Monitor homologation validity dates and proactively manage renewals to prevent service disruption or import blocks.
  • Continuously improve certification lead time, cost efficiency, and regulatory predictability through optimization strategies.

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  • Interface directly with Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Product Engineering, Test & Certification, Supply Chain, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Translate global product roadmaps and engineering changes into Brazilian regulatory requirements and execution plans.
  • Act as the internal regulatory authority and trusted advisor on Brazilian telecommunications regulations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in regulatory affairs, product certification, or compliance within the telecommunications industry.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Anatel homologation processes, especially for Class III (network infrastructure) equipment.
  • Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, EMC, electrical safety, and telecom network technologies (RAN, MW, IP, Optical, CPE).
  • English as primary working language is mandatory; Portuguese fluency is required; Advanced Mandarin is desirable.
  • Ability to operate autonomously with strong ownership, sound judgment, and assertive decision-making.

What Success Looks Like

Zero expired or non-compliant homologations.

No import blocks or deployment delays caused by regulatory issues.

Reduced certification lead time and re-test costs.

Full regulatory visibility and predictability for leadership, engineering, and sales.

Recognition as the internal authority on Anatel and Brazilian telecom regulation.

Why This Role Matters

This is strategic, technical, and business-critical role when you can face challenge and develop yourself.

Without regulatory compliance, products do not enter the country and networks do not go live.

With strong regulatory leadership, the company operates faster, safer, and more competitively in Brazil.

Are you interested in being part of our team? Please apply for this opportunity and attach your resume in English. Kindly note that only English resumes will be considered.

title: Analista de Gestão de Pessoas Júnior (Benefícios - Florestal)

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Teltonika IoT Solutions Brazil is a representative branch of Teltonika IoT Group, which has been creating and manufacturing Internet of Things (IoT) for over 20 years. From connected vehicles to networking, we seek our solutions to be used globally and become an indispensable part of any business. By setting new trends, we inspire our partners to change the world and use the most advanced technologies in the market.

We are constantly growing and looking for an organized IoT Solutions Engineering Specialist to join our team in São Paulo, SP .

In this role, you will:

  • Work with various Teltonika Telematics-manufactured GNSS tracking devices that embed technologies such as Bluetooth, CANbus, RS232/RS485, and 1-Wire
  • Propose different ways on how to incorporate our devices for various use cases
  • Be responsible for arranging technical tasks for custom development projects and coordinating solution release to clients
  • Troubleshoot, provide assistance, and consult clients via a dedicated ticketing system or online meetings/chats if they are needed
  • Communicate with global international corporations that provide car sharing, rental, fleet management solutions and various other companies from different vehicle telematics fields
  • Cooperate with R&D, quality assurance and project management teams to ensure the maintenance of the projects and that solutions reach the clients on time
  • Have an opportunity to go on business trips to visit clients and help them directly implement Teltonika devices into their business use cases.
  • Guide colleagues and customers by preparing wiki documentation or training

What we expect of you:

  • Great communication skills, are capable of fluently speaking and writing in English (proficiency in other languages will be considered as an advantage)
  • Telecommunications, electronics, informatics, engineering education or previous work experience in technical or engineering fields
  • Passion for providing help to others, caring, willing to grow and enrich your technological know-how
  • Analytical and creative thinking and mindset for problem-solving and troubleshooting
  • Understanding or basic knowledge of telecommunication technologies (2G, GPRS, 3G, 4G), CANbus, BLE
  • Knowledge or work experience working with ticketing-based platforms (Jira, GitLab, OpenProject, ServiceDesk) (this will be considered as an advantage)
  • Experience in customer service (this will be considered as an advantage)

What we offer:

  • Salary : We appreciate everyone's efforts and experiences, so we offer an attractive salary matching your skillset and field expertise.
  • Career : Great opportunities to grow in a strong and rapidly expanding company.
  • Work model: Hybrid (4 days in person and one remote)
  • Catering benefits: Cartão Caju (Vale Refeição of R$35 per working days + Saldo Livre of R$750 monthly + R$09 per working day), coffee and fruits provided in the office;
  • Health and Well-being Benefits: TotalPass, SESC membership, healthcare, dental care, and life insurance.
  • Teambuilding: regular office celebrations and events that help us to get to know each other better.
  • Caring and supportive team: we constantly seek for our employees to have better leadership while regularly sending our managers to external coaching sessions, conducting annual employee engagement surveys, and other management and HRD initiatives to help our employees overcome bottlenecks and challenges.

Teltonika aspires to become one of the global leaders in providing unique IoT solutions that contribute to making people’s lives easier. Since 1998, we have gained considerable experience and competence in electronics development and production. Today, our areas of expertise include telematics, networking, telemedicine, EV charging, and electronics manufacturing. While proactively searching for new ideas and ways to create more value for our clients, we also hope to create a better future for our employees and the communities we operate in. Our organizational culture is based on mutual trust and respect as well as creating synergy with our employees and clients.

description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra.

O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Lead Training Consultant - SAP IBP & ePPDS
description:
About Company::

Bristlecone is a supply chain and business analytics advisor, serving customers across a wide range of industries. Rated by Gartner as among the top ten system integrators in the supply chain space, we are uniquely positioned to solve contemporary business problems, with supply chain and analytics focus as our advantage. We have been a trusted partner and advisor to many leading, globally recognized companies such as Applied Materials, Exxon Mobil, Flextronics, LSI Logic, Mahindra, Motorola, Nestle, Palm, Qatar Petroleum, Ranbaxy, Unilever and Whirlpool and many others.

Role Overview:

Language Required- Spanish Speaking

Should be open to travel to Mexico on needed basis

Role Objective

The Lead Training Consultant will be responsible for the end-to-end educational lifecycle of our digital supply chain transformation. This role requires a unique individual who can not only configure SAP IBP and ePPDS modules but also translate complex technical processes into comprehensive training programs for diverse business audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Training Strategy: Conduct comprehensive Training Needs Analysis (TNA) to identify skill gaps and design a global curriculum covering SAP IBP (Demand, S&OP, Response & Supply) and ePPDS.
  • Content Development: Create high-quality, multi-format training materials including Instructor-Led Training (ILT) decks, Quick Reference Guides (QRGs), video tutorials, and interactive eLearning modules.
  • Hands-on Facilitation: Deliver engaging training sessions to Super Users and End Users, utilizing real-world business scenarios in a dedicated training environment.
  • Environment Management: Manage and maintain the SAP training landscape (Sandbox), ensuring master data is refreshed and aligned for practical hands-on labs.
  • Post-Go-Live Support: Provide critical Hypercare support and refresher training post-deployment to ensure high system adoption and user proficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Technical Mastery: Deep functional knowledge of SAP IBP (specifically Order-Based Planning ) and ePPDS (embedded Production Planning & Detailed Scheduling) in S/4HANA.
  • Training Expertise: Proven experience in end-to-end training delivery for large-scale SAP implementations, from curriculum design to final assessment.
  • Process Knowledge: Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, capacity planning, and detailed production scheduling.
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical users.
  • Certification: SAP IBP or SCM Professional certification is highly preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful execution of the global training calendar within project timelines.
  • High user adoption rates and positive training effectiveness scores.
  • Minimal post-go-live support tickets related to "lack of knowledge" or process errors

title: Sales Operations Analyst
description:
What is the scope of this role?

The Sales Operations Analyst will be responsible for optimizing sales processes, providing analytical support, and managing sales tools to ensure that our sales organization meets its targets. This role requires a blend of proactive thinking, operational expertise, and excellent communication skills.

  • Help prepare presentations and materials for the global sales team as needed.

  • Familiarity with any Sales Force automation tool
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools
  • Proven experience managing simultaneous multiple priorities
  • Ability to partner cross functionally throughout the company
  • Strong MS excel and PPT skills
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent communication skills in verbal and written English
  • Knowledge of business communication via emailing, presentations, conference meetings
  • Strong organizational and decision-making skills
  • University Degree required

Atribuições da função:

Elaborar contratos de bens e serviços (inclui aditivos e termos de apoio/patrocínios), utilizando normas jurídicas, políticas internas e boas práticas de compliance e alinhando necessidades técnicas específicas com as áreas envolvidas e fornecedores - sempre que necessário -, com o objetivo de garantir clareza, validade legal e alinhamento às demandas institucionais.

Negociar renovação contratual, analisando objeto e as cláusulas do contrato, articulando com fornecedores, avaliando propostas, comparando custos, prazos e formalizando acordos, visando melhores condições comerciais e contratuais (ex.: otimização de custos e redução de riscos) em conformidade com a legislação e normativos internos.

Elaborar instrumentos/termos jurídicos (ex.: parcerias e patrocínios/apoios), bem como pareceres, com base em legislação jurídica, normativos internos e boas práticas de compliance, alinhados às necessidades das áreas demandantes e áreas envolvidas (ex.: Jurídico e Finanças), quando necessário, com foco na clareza, validade legal e diretrizes institucionais.

Atender demandas de contratos, articulando com área demandante, Jurídico e Financeiro, participando de reuniões, esclarecendo cláusulas contratuais e prestando orientações sobre normativos internos e procedimentos de contratação (direta ou licitação), legislação e jurisprudência correlacionada, visando alinhamento institucional e conformidade legal que atendam aos orientadores estratégicos.

Atender as contratações relativas a direitos autorais e patrimoniais, mediante análise jurídica da demanda, verificação do enquadramento legal, realização de verificação jurídica “clearance’, interlocução com autores e intervenientes, elaboração dos instrumentos específicos (contratos de edição, cessão, licenciamento, autorizações e declarações), bem como condução de tratativas e negociações, a fim de assegurar a regularização do uso das obras e garantir a conformidade legal e institucional das contratações realizadas pelo Senac DN.

Elaborar e manter atualizados relatórios periódicos sobre contratos ativos e desempenho de fornecedores, utilizando sistemas específicos/ ferramentas de BI e consolidando dados em indicadores e dashboards para fornecer informações importantes e subsidiar tomada de decisão (ex.: identificação de desvios para correção e melhoria de processos).

Avaliar e monitorar riscos contratuais e assegurar aderência às normas legais e regulatórias, aplicando controles internos, participando de auditorias e mantendo registros atualizados, com o objetivo de preservar a integridade institucional e mitigar riscos para a empresa.

Executar outras atividades, correlatas às descritas, desde que de mesma natureza e equivalentes graus de responsabilidade e complexidade.

title: Coordenador(a) Manutenção Logística
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Desafio:

Planejar, coordenar e controlar as atividades de manutenção da frota e dos ativos logísticos, assegurando alta disponibilidade operacional, segurança, confiabilidade e otimização de custos, em alinhamento com as metas da gerência, produção e nível de serviço da Arauco.

Principais Atividades:

  • Assegurar a execução do plano de manutenção das frotas sob sua responsabilidade, monitorando os pontos críticos do fluxo e antecipando riscos, com intervenções rápidas para evitar rupturas e impactos na produção.
  • Liderar e auditar o desempenho das equipes próprias e terceiras parceiras, monitorando disponibilidade de frota, produtividade, segurança e custo.
  • Gerir os custos da área, realizando a previsão orçamentária anual e o acompanhamento mensal do realizado, por meio de aprovações de gastos, análises críticas e ações de otimização para garantir aderência ao orçamento.
  • Acompanhar e analisar os indicadores de gestão (KPIs) das empresas prestadoras de serviço, garantindo a aderência contratual e a sustentabilidade econômico-financeira dos contratos sob sua gestão.
  • Conduzir a melhoria contínua, mapeando oportunidades, priorizando iniciativas e assegurando a implementação de ações que elevem segurança, produtividade, qualidade e eficiência de custos.
  • Participar da construção do planejamento semanal, mensal e anual de manutenção, assim como construir em conjunto com as áreas clientes como será o plano operacional dos períodos.
  • Gerenciar a manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva da frota logística (caminhões, carretas, implementos, equipamentos de apoio, gruas, tractors, etc).
  • Estruturar modelo de governança para acompanhamento dos resultados e planos de ação dos desvios.
  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe, assegurando clima organizacional positivo e alinhamento aos pilares de segurança, qualidade, produtividade e eficiência de custos, por meio de acompanhamento, orientação e suporte contínuos e participação ativa na construção e plano de recrutamento, seleção e treinamento.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade da área e diretrizes da liderança.
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir as políticas de Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional e Ética/Compliance, junto a colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando aderência à legislação, compromissos corporativos e requisitos normativos (normas e ISOs aplicáveis) em atividades, produtos e serviços.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Logística, Administração, Economia, Engenharias relacionadas às áreas florestal, civil e industrial ou áreas correlatas;

title: School Coordinator (K-12 Schools) (B2B)
description:
Partner Success Coordinator (K-12 Schools) (Customer Success, B2B)

******IMPORTANT******

Qualification: Mid (4yrs+) in academic coordination/operations, program management, or Customer Success

English: Fluent

Contract: PJ

Compensation: Salary + Bonus, depending on experience

Location: Hybrid, 3+ days on-site in Sao Paulo (Zona Sul); availability for nationwide travel (evenings/weekends as needed).

**********************

About Us

WorldEd is an established K–12 school with an international footprint built through long-term partnerships with schools and educational institutions. We support partners with high-quality academic programs, clear processes, and a delivery model designed for real implementation. As we grow, we’re tightening operations with people who execute reliably, ensuring strong partner experience and on-time student outcomes.

Job Overview

You'll own the day-to-day success of WorldEd's partner schools, ensuring programs run smoothly, academic processes execute on time, and students progress without delays. This role combines partner relationship management with academic operations and deadline-driven execution.

Most work is done from our office (hybrid), supporting schools remotely through monitoring, coordination, reporting, and problem-solving. However, this is a travel-heavy role during key academic periods (onboarding, start-of-term implementation, trainings, quality checks, strategic visits). During these periods, expect demanding schedules with frequent trips and full-day on-site work.

This role requires full ownership: consistent follow-through, early risk escalation, accurate record-keeping, and driving issues to resolution without reminders.

Critical Operations Coverage (important)

Occasionally, urgent academic or partner issues arise outside standard hours (including breaks). When this happens, you must be reachable, respond promptly, and help drive resolution, especially when student progress, compliance, or partner trust is at risk. This is occasional, not constant, but we take responsibility when something critical needs handling.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own assigned partner schools as primary contact; maintain strong relationships with coordinators, teachers, and stakeholders
  • Provide day-to-day partner support across channels (WhatsApp, email, calls) with fast follow-up and clear communication
  • Lead on-site visits during travel-intensive periods to align expectations, deliver trainings, run quality checks, and drive action plans (including occasional weekends)
  • Ensure consistent implementation of WorldEd curriculum, methodology, resources, and instructional technology
  • Monitor student progress and operations (completion, grades, deadlines); proactively flag risks and coordinate interventions
  • Troubleshoot academic and technology issues; escalate when needed and own resolution through closure
  • Enforce WorldEd academic policies and quality standards (integrity, attendance, grading), including evidence reviews and corrective actions
  • Maintain auditable documentation in LMS/SIS and shared trackers; provide regular reporting to partners and leadership with risks, actions, owners, and due dates

Success Metrics (LAER-aligned)

Measured by: Retention, Adoption, Completion, SLA/Responsiveness, and NPS/Satisfaction across your assigned partner schools.

Qualifications

Required

  • 4+ years in academic coordination/operations, program management, customer success, or partner success (international or multi-school partnerships strongly preferred)
  • Strong operational execution: accurate tracking, consistent follow-up, reliable delivery against timelines
  • Strong stakeholder management: ability to run trainings, handle sensitive conversations, coordinate across multiple decision-makers
  • Systems and data-oriented: proficient with LMS/online platforms and dashboards/trackers; quick to learn new tools
  • Fluent English required
  • Full availability to travel, including demanding schedules during specific periods, with on-site full days and occasional weekends

This role is not for you if… (important)

  • … you’re not fully available to travel or you want a role that is primarily office-only.
  • … you avoid follow-up and don’t like operating with deadlines, checklists, and accountability.
  • … you prefer “handing off” problems instead of owning them through to resolution.
  • … you expect rigid boundaries regardless of context and won’t step in when something critical needs to be handled.

What We Offer

  • A culture in a constantly growing segment with continuous learning opportunities.
  • Full scholarship for direct dependents in WorldEd’s Programs.
  • Total Pass wellness and quality of life benefit.
  • Hybrid work model: Sao Paulo (Zona Sul) office + home-office + regular partner visits nationwide.
  • Parking at headquarters.
  • Compensation plan, consisting of a fixed monthly amount + bonus plan tied to goals.

If you’re passionate about helping students succeed through high-quality education, disciplined about operational execution, strong in partner relationship management, and fully available to travel as needed to drive partner success on-site, we want to hear from you.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE - Carbon Real Estate Investments

The Role

You set meetings. The CIO takes them.

Carbon is a real estate investment firm raising capital from accredited investors — family offices and high-net-worth individuals. Your role is to get qualified investors on the calendar. You identify the opportunity, book the meeting, and prepare the brief. What happens in the meeting is not your responsibility.

Who You're Reaching

Accredited investors who can write $250K-$5M+ checks — family office principals, high-net-worth individuals, RIAs, fund managers, and allocators. You're also booking guests for the Deal Flow Podcast — that's the content engine that drives brand, inbound leads, and audience growth. And you'll manage social engagement: monitoring, replying, and engaging on behalf of the brand to support the sales motion.

This means you need to sound credible. You're not cold calling small businesses—you're engaging with people who manage significant capital and expect a professional, informed approach.

Tools & Infrastructure

You'll have access to:

• LinkedIn Sales Navigator (multiple profiles)

• Apollo for contact enrichment and prospecting

• Email infrastructure with AI SDR capabilities

• Salesforge for sequence management

Requirements

This role requires existing appointment setting experience. We are not training from scratch.

• 2+ years of SDR, appointment setting, or outbound sales experience

• Proven track record booking meetings at volume

• Proficiency with Sales Navigator, Apollo, or similar tools

• Experience managing multi-channel outreach (email, LinkedIn, phone)

• Strong English communication skills, written and verbal

• Self-directed — you manage your pipeline without daily oversight

Ideal Background

• Experience in financial services, financial products, or capital raising

• Background in real estate, private equity, alternative investments, or traditional investment products

Success Metric

5 qualified meetings per week is table stakes. That's the minimum to stay past 90 days. Top performers do 10-15.

• ~4 investor meetings per week (200/year) — accredited investors, family offices, HNW

• ~1 podcast guest per week (50/year) — fuels the content engine that drives inbound and brand

You'll ramp to that target over 90 days.

Compensation

• Base salary: $1,500 - $2,100 USD/month (depending on experience)

• Podcast bonus: $100 per guest booked (up to ~$800/month at target)

• Variable comp: % of capital raised from meetings you source

• Year 1 potential: $50,000 - $70,000+ USD at strong performance

Location

  • Remote. Must be available during US Eastern business hours.

Recruitment Process

To ensure a strong fit, our recruitment process includes the following steps:

  1. Typing Test – Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a words-per-minute typing test (minimum benchmark required).
  2. One-Minute Video Submission – Candidates who pass the typing test will submit a brief video introduction.
  3. Resume Review & Interviews – Selected candidates will move forward to resume review, an HR interview, and a final interview with senior leadership.

Only candidates who complete all steps will be considered.

description:
Descrição Sumária

Definir os parâmetros operacionais da planta industrial, através da elaboração e acompanhamento dos balanços de massa e energia, bem como realizar a gestão do controle de processos da unidade industrial, desde a concepção dos P&IDs até a implantação na engenharia de automação, buscando sempre propostas de melhoria para os processos, visando a otimização dos ativos e a maximização dos resultados industriais.

Principais Responsabilidades :

• Realizar balanços de massa e energia, bem como a modelagem e a simulação do processo produtivo existente ou novo (visando sua otimização) e avaliar sua condição de operação e performance, certificando-se do cumprimento das normas/padrões e evitando desperdícios nos processos industriais e apoiar em novas certificações e licenças;

• Atuar como facilitador no processo de gerenciamento de mudança (MOC) e garantir a execução das etapas necessárias para o processo de comissionamento e startup das operações;

• Fazer análise crítica dos resultados laboratoriais e boletins industriais (ex: cálculos de eficiências etc.), e assim conduzir as reuniões diárias a fim de coordenar os trabalhos para melhoria contínua de processos e seus resultados, evitando reincidências indesejadas;

• Ser o responsável pela definição e implantação dos projetos de controle e automação de processos industriais (bem como elaboração e atualização de P&IDs – diagramas de tubulação e instrumentação) e, também, pela captação de oportunidades/elaboração de novos projetos, junto à área corporativa de engenharia, a fim de maximizar a segurança operacional e de processos, além de garantir a otimização de recursos;

• Garantir que todos os tanques e equipamentos de processos estejam devidamente arqueados e seus dados registrados no software de controle industrial (PIMS PI);

• Ser responsável pelo desdobramento da estratégia relacionada ao planejamento industrial, desde o nível orçamentário até o planejamento semanal de produção (PSPI), mantendo a comunicação entre as áreas de Planejamento, Corporativa de Processos e Engenharia, Comercial e Planejamento Agrícola;

• Planejar e orientar as equipes técnicas no que diz respeito ao cumprimento da dosagem de insumos, auxiliando na identificação de fatores externos que possam interferir nos parâmetros técnicos requeridos, bem como apoiar no mapeamento das oportunidades de redução de consumos de insumos, além de eventual substituição/homologação de princípios ativos e/ou fornecedores, conforme procedimento vigente;

• Suportar a área da Qualidade em eventuais reclamações de clientes, liderando time de investigação de causa raiz e garantindo a elaboração e execução dos planos de ação para correção e mitigação dos desvios;

• Participar das análises de segurança (por exemplo, HAZOP, LOPA etc.), assim como de estudos ambientais e elaborar as etapas de troubleshooting/desvios de processo e conceitos de PSM (Gestão de Segurança de Processo) das POP’s e/ou documentos de produção/processo (com o objetivo de identificar e corrigir/mitigar riscos operacionais);

• Acompanhar a fiscalização nos processos de auditoria dos produtos elaborados pela empresa, dando informações adequadas para a solução de problemas;

• Coordenar e desenvolver continuamente o seu time de subordinados, mantendo o foco em relação às responsabilidades e atividades da área de Processos e Engenharia, primando sempre por segurança e otimizando o uso de recursos sob sua gestão;

• Exercer as atividades de gestão em comum acordo com os valores, Código de Ética e Conduta, políticas, diretrizes e procedimentos da Empresa;

• Assegurar que as Políticas e Procedimentos em matéria de HSE são comunicadas, entendidas e aplicadas na organização, trabalhando com a meta de nenhum acidente, nenhum dano às pessoas e nenhum dano ao meio ambiente.

Requisitos Necessários:

• Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Química e/ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência sólida em processos de açúcar e etanol;

• Conhecimento em balanços de massa e energia, bem como em simuladores de processos industriais;

• Conhecimento desejável em ferramentas de melhoria contínua e em segurança de processos;

• Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente em Edéia – GO

title: Analista Contábil Sênior

Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!

Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!

Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora

Conheça esta oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro/ Cash e se você possui os requisitos para a vaga, FAÇA JÁ A SUA INSCRIÇÃO.

  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo suporte técnico e documentação de suporte;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos contábeis e controles internos;
  • Desenvolver e manter controles internos contábeis, alinhados às práticas de compliance e governança corporativa.

title: Client Engagement Associate
description:
Job Title : Client Engagement Associate

Location : São Paulo, Brazil

Department : Client Engagement

Reports to : Client Engagement Managing Director

Job Overview: 

Join a fast-growing FinTech reinventing how businesses manage risk and transact worldwide.

Deaglo is looking for a driven Client Engagement Associate to join our Brasil Client Engagement Team. We empower corporates, asset managers, and financial institutions around the world with cutting-edge, data-driven Global risk management, accounting, and technology solutions across FX and interest rates.

As part of the Client Engagement Team, you will play a hands-on role in driving commercial growth by identifying new opportunities, developing outbound strategies, and initiating conversations with key decision-makers across corporates and investment funds. This is a great opportunity for someone with early commercial experience who wants to take ownership and grow quickly in a high-performance environment.

Key Responsibilities: 

What You’ll Do

Lead Generation & Market Research

  • Proactively identify and research potential clients through cold calls, outbound emails, social media, and digital tools.
  • Qualify leads based on Deaglo’s ideal customer profile and strategic fit.

Pipeline & Opportunity Development

  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline from initial contact through qualification.
  • Set and attend discovery meetings with senior stakeholders to understand client needs.

Strategic Outreach

  • Execute structured, multi-channel outbound campaigns using LinkedIn, phone, and email.
  • Drive engagement and ensure low no-show rates with personalized follow-ups and meeting confirmations.

Sales Process & CRM Management

  • Maintain accurate records and activity tracking in HubSpot.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and contribute insights to continuously improve targeting and messaging.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with senior Risk Management, marketing, and product teams to optimize value propositions and outreach strategies.
  • Provide market feedback to influence campaign design and product positioning.

Requirements: 

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 2+ years in sales outreach, lead generation, or business development roles (BDR /SDR). Experience in consulting firms, financial services, fintech, or SaaS is preferred. 
  • Skills: Understanding of financial markets and related instruments, including risk management products and derivatives.
  • Sales Fundamentals: Confidence in initiating conversations and handling objections.
  • Tools & Tech: Proficiency with CRMs (especially HubSpot), sales engagement tools, and Google Workspace.
  • Languages: Native-level proficiency in Portuguese and upper-intermediate to advanced proficiency in English (B2–C1 level) is required. Spanish is a plus.
  • Communication: Clear, concise communicator with excellent interpersonal skills and a client-focused mindset.
  • Ownership & Structure: Organized, KPI-driven, and capable of self-managing your outreach plans and performance analysis.
  • Growth Mindset: Eagerness to learn, iterate, and take on new challenges in a fast-paced environment.

Benefits: 

  • Competitive compensation package, including performance based incentives.
  • Strategic visibility across firm leadership and key stakeholders
  • Dynamic in office environment
  • A chance to build and mold a team.
  • Unlimited PTO

About Deaglo:

Deaglo is a global financial services consultancy that combines advanced technology with institutional expertise to help clients manage financial risk with precision and confidence.

Established in 2019, Deaglo delivers integrated solutions across foreign exchange risk management, interest rate risk management, and accounting services, empowering clients to make informed, strategic decisions in dynamic markets.

Deaglo works seamlessly with organizations to simplify complex exposures, enhance financial performance, and optimize operational efficiency. From strategy through execution, Deaglo provides the clarity, control, and confidence needed to achieve lasting results.
